milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining chiseled_red_sandstone with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no chiseled_red_sandstone in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting sandstone_wall places the crafted item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no sandstone_wall, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting. The recipe (6 sandstone → 6 sandstone_wall) requires the crafting table in the scene, and 16 sandstone blocks are available on the platform. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
